what: Body/move pairs already declared in staged fixtures that the authority's TeamValidator refuses. The learnset clause in tests/staged_board.js REPORTS these and fails only on a pair not listed here. Keyed species|move, so the same illegal pair moved to a new scenario is NEW.
why: The clause was added 2026-08-12 and these violations predate it. Repairing each one changes what its scenario measures, so they are their own batch — folding eight fixture rewrites into the pass that ADDS the check makes both unattributable. The list may only SHRINK.
